notifications.title: Bluebird v2.0 — The Beginning of Beauty ✨
notifications.body: The most awaited Bluebird release is here! v2.0 brings a complete transformation with Fluent System Icons, Mobile Mode, a VS Code-inspired Text Editor, the new BPK app system, new built-in apps, major UI improvements, and much more. Update through Settings or visit bluebirduganda.dpdns.org.

notifications.title: A New Bluebird Begins
notifications.body: Bluebird v2.0 is more than an update — it is a complete transformation. Nearly every part of Bluebird has been revisited for a more beautiful, capable, and efficient experience.

notifications.title: 7.5 MB. A Lot More Inside. ⚡
notifications.body: Bluebird v2.0 introduces R8/ProGuard optimization and resource shrinking, reducing the release APK from approximately 24 MB in v1.9 to just 7.5 MB — while retaining the major Bluebird experience.

notifications.title: Build Your Own Web Apps in Bluebird 🌐
notifications.body: Want to run your own web app inside Bluebird? With the new BPK system, you can build and package custom applications for the Bluebird environment. Follow the Bluebird BPK Documentation to learn how to get started.
